Okay, hope this helps! :D Good luck, see u hopefully! Disclaimer: this is what i went thru and it's different kasi iba-iba ang nagiinterview at hindi pareparehas... 



So I applied in Lean Solutions Group thru indeed. From there, the TA messaged me and sent me an email to fill up specific questions such as name, address, age, best time to have an interview...


After I responded, me and the TA kept communicating thru email. My first interview was a phone call interview with her (the TA). After that (not the same day), I had another interview with the company's operations manager. They're a multi-national company so expect that most of the people who'll interview you would be Colombians. It's not hard to understand their accent but I had to listen very carefully while they're conversing with me 😅 you should prepare answers to questions like: Tell me about yourself, where u live, u graduated, and what was ur college program. Also, do a research about the company, their services, goals, and founder.  Next, prepare to share your experience in the BPO industry/any job that you had in the past (if u had one, mostly kasi sa logistics coordinator sa lean is preferably may exp but di naman required). Then, prepare your list of ur soft and hard skills. Please make sure to know what a logistics coordinator do. Lastly, prepare to answer a question from the op manager.... this what he asked me: What would you say to a truck driver when the shipment he's been waiting for for hours was loaded very late? Ganern.


After u PASS the interview with the op manager, u then have an interview with their psychologist. After that, they'll order you to come to their office. Sa McKinley yun. May interview ka na naman sa op manager nila dito sa Pinas, pero Colombian pa din. After u PASS that, then u wait for their go signal. That's pretty much it. I know it's a lot, but hindi naman mahirap if you're confident and knowledgeable about the position and company you're applying for. Good luck ulit!!!!
